b) Reference object: the bread pieces are about 11 cm long. The plate spans roughly 2.5 bread-lengths across the width of the image (from about x=150 to x=610, i.e. about 460 px; one bread piece is about 180-200 px long), giving about 2.3-2.5 lengths, so width is roughly 25-27 cm.

- Green filling: about 15 g → about 4 kcal
